articles.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
articles.description: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: State AGs fight Character AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats
articles.description: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it
articles.description: Arizona Land Consulting’s CEO joins Equity to talk about the land behind the AI boom, what it takes to find a data center site with power, zoning, and community buy-in, and what Nvidia getting pickier means for neoclouds.

articles.title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
articles.description: Amazon and Meta are discussing a potential deal that would end a two-month-long blockade of Muse.
articles.author: Lauren Forristal

articles.title: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
articles.description: The central question for investigators is what Nvidia knew about where those chips ended up and whether Huang's affair with a Megaspeed executive gave the company reason to doubt Megaspeed's assurances.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
articles.description: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Jensen Huang still thinks a succession plan creates unnecessary hierarchy
articles.description: It's a remarkable stance for a company that spent the last two weeks finding out what happens without its founder.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: In all-hands meeting, Jensen Huang thanks White House and says he’s in therapy
articles.description: The Nvidia founder apologized to his staff on Tuesday and said he was grateful for a second chance to lead the company.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
articles.description: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
articles.description: Walmart now lets customers shop Black Friday deals through Muse, Meta’s AI agent.
articles.author: Lauren Forristal
